description: `prose cost` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli run quote --help`, and the Action names `cli wallet usage`; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `cost` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli run quote --help`? `cli run quote FILE` prices a run before it starts; past spending is `cli wallet usage`. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: Past spending is `cli wallet usage`. Use `cli run quote`; `prose cli run quote --help` shows its arguments.
